ctu1.sentence: The applicant must also possess the necessary documents to prove their identity and registration as a construction worker.

ctu2.sentence: Additionally, proof of registration with the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board is mandatory.

ctu1.sentence: First, the applicant must visit the official website of the respective state welfare board.

ctu2.sentence: They need to download the application form available on the website.

ctu1.sentence: The completed application form must be submitted along with the required documents.

ctu2.sentence: Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.
